V3/V4 Turbo32 keeps the stack-free 135-ZP overlay but uses a direct-I/O resident adapter; reference range $0A-$90, legal origins $02-$79; BEGIN/CALL/END = 326 / 684.185219 mean / 371 cycles on the canonical corpus, with a 116-product crossover versus normal UMUL32.
The retained ACME certificate predates the current OptiSearch update; current external ACME validation was not run.
A 285-row consolidated routine table covers every stable API in V1-V5 plus V3/V4 Turbo and V4 QS16, including cycles, reachable code bytes, ZP and persistent stack-page reservation.
Signed APIs own signed semantics; selected fast division paths may share certified unsigned magnitude substrates only through explicit signed-layout validator exceptions.
Signed ownership validator: 279 checks and 65/65 zero-overlap signed/unsigned executable comparisons across V1-V5.
Signed arithmetic regression: 264,999 multiply calls and 364,533 divide/modulo calls, zero errors.
Same-corpus division-family audit covers 23 public paths per profile and reports zero timing regressions in V1-V5.
V2-V4 retain the executable-ZP native SMUL16 kernel; V1/V5 keep the 31-byte normal-ZP contract using private signed arithmetic paths in already-reserved resident holes.

Custom Pareto Builder added for stock-C64 games/demos: total ZP budget, optional exact extra-RAM budget, init policy and routine weights select the fastest certified compatible V1/V2 implementation set at build time.
Custom Pareto selection has no runtime dispatcher and retains the same 56-entry public API.
Default equal-weight Pareto breakpoints are 31/36/60/147/176/221 ZP bytes.
31 ZP + zero extra RAM reproduces V1 byte-for-byte; 31 ZP + optional-init policy reproduces V5 byte-for-byte; 221 ZP selects complete V2.
RAM budgeting is exact for generated private payload, including the exact emitted MATH_INIT helper; generated manifests list every private RAM and ZP range.

Pareto validation covers 12 reference/alternate builds and 257,064 common-API calls, 75,644 direct V2 cycle-parity cases, exhaustive UMOD8, 50,144 SMUL16 parity cases, 25,000 mixed iterations, 10,000 ZP-guard iterations, deterministic rebuilds and 12 resource/config cases.
V5 Hybrid Low-ZP adds a fifth stock-C64 profile while preserving the common 56-entry API.
V5 keeps V1 normal ZP at 31 bytes and imports certified V2 division/modulo/COS/SINCOS paths with no runtime dispatcher tax.
V5 ordinary safe entries retain V1-style optional MATH_INIT; 2,000 cold-load calls across reference/alternate maps validate this.
Sequential calls, including repeated calls inside game/demo loops, are supported; the library remains non-reentrant.
V5 reference private code uses RAM under BASIC ROM at $A000-$BDFF; bank BASIC out or relocate HYBRID_CODE.
DOCUMENTED LEAN FINAL adds a plain-English Turbo explanation and removes reproducible/superseded packaging waste; code, ABI, overlays and deployable REU data are unchanged.
DOCUMENTED LEAN FINAL includes the complete user/integration manual; resident code, overlays, REU arithmetic data, ABI and performance are unchanged from Turbo FINAL.
The common 56-entry stable API is unchanged across V1-V4.
V3/V4 additionally expose six stateful Turbo16/Turbo32 BEGIN/CALL/END entries.
Turbo executable-ZP origins and REU storage banks are selected at build time; overlay code is assembled from canonical source with no runtime relocation pass.
Reference and alternate Turbo cycle vectors are identical; relocation adds zero runtime cycles.
Fast exact independently derived ISQRT32 remains active; V4 uses 512 resident square-table bytes at $9800-$99FF.
ATAN2 profile integration: V1 uses compact_opt (47.462814 mean, 512 B tables); V2/V3/V5 use sum_fast (43.970627 mean, 1024 B tables); V4 retains exact REU ATAN2.

Turbo16 public CALL keeps the exact 113-byte overlay but removes a redundant x1 reload: 211.544111 mean cycles (199-236), BEGIN/END 282/327, 43-product crossover versus normal UMUL16; relocation and boundary cycle vectors remain identical.
V2/V3/V4 public UMUL16 uses the resource-neutral A=x1/direct-Z0 adaptation: 216.980037 mean cycles (205-240), 16 ZP bytes; UMUL16_SHR8 is 257.980037 mean and remains exactly +41 cycles.

All-profile public UMUL24 direct-output update: V1/V5 474.042329 mean (444-530), V2/V3/V4 429.555502 mean (400-485), exactly 18 cycles saved on every call in the 10,324-case old-vs-new comparison; 24-ZP/table contracts unchanged.

All-profile public SMUL24 direct-output update: V1/V5 513.496472/512.874222, V2/V3/V4 469.181818/468.816106/469.220008; exactly 18 cycles removed from every call, with 24-ZP/table/quadrant contracts unchanged.

All-profile 16-bit fixed-point register-return update: UMUL16_SHR8 is base+31 cycles in V1/V5 and base+27 in V2/V3/V4; SMUL16_SHR8 is base+31 in all profiles. This removes 10/14 unsigned cycles and 10 signed cycles per call with no resource-contract change.
